abstract: Having favored online meetings for many years now, the DVB Project was well placed to adapt to life during a global pandemic. There was no let-up in pace over the past year as our members continued their consensus-based work to build new internet-centric solutions for the future of media delivery.

authors.bio: Emily Dubs took up her current position as the head of technology in January 2020, coming to DVB with 20 years’ experience in the digital television industry. Previously, she worked with Thomson Video Networks, Cesson-Sévigné, France (now Harmonic), TeamCast, Cesson-Sévigné, France (now ENENSYS), and SmarDTV/Neotion, Aubagne, France, in roles covering both traditional broadcast technologies and those emerging from the broadband world.
